gloss: to pull down; to drag down; to withdraw (money)

definitions.gloss: to pull down; to drag down from a high position
definitions.explanation: To physically pull or drag something or someone down from a higher place.

definitions.gloss: to force someone out of a position; to topple
definitions.explanation: To remove someone from a position of power or authority, often forcefully or against their will.

definitions.gloss: to withdraw money from a bank account
definitions.explanation: To take money out of a savings or bank account. A common everyday usage.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) + ⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ (to lower, bring down). Transitive verb (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧). The physical sense (pulling something down) extends naturally to the figurative sense of removing someone from power, and the financial sense of withdrawing money.

TRANSITIVITY: transitive (paired with no standard intransitive form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to pull down from a shelf
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to drag down from a position of power
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to withdraw money
- ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{下|お}ろす: to withdraw savings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧: to pull out, to withdraw -- more general; also used for money
- ⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧: to lower, to take down -- simpler form without the pulling nuance
- {引|ひ}きずり⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧: to drag down forcefully -- more emphatic and aggressive
